questions.prompt_text: City and county leaders should show how they spend our tax money.
Leaders should work hard to bring good-paying jobs to my area.
Feeling safe in my neighborhood is one of my biggest worries.
Rent and home prices cost too much where I live.
Good public schools are key to my community's future.
Leaders should make health care and mental health help easier to afford.
Fixing roads, sidewalks, and buses should be a top job in my area.
Voting in local elections makes a real difference where I live.
I trust local leaders to make good choices without people checking on them.
Helping small local businesses matters more to me than most issues.
My area is already safe, so safety is not a big issue for me.
New buildings in my area should be homes people can afford.
Kids and teens here need more safe places and programs after school.
Staying healthy is up to each person. Leaders should not focus on it.
It should be easier to get around my city without a car.
Going to community meetings or calling leaders is a waste of my time.

personas.name: The Watchdog
personas.one_line: You want to see the receipts. Open records and clear votes matter most to you.
personas.strength: You notice when something does not add up. You help keep leaders honest by asking clear questions and reading the record.
personas.blind_spot: Not every delay is a cover up, and sometimes a slow answer is just a busy office.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand in the tradition of investigative journalists, auditors, and open records advocates.
personas.archetype_examples: Investigative journalists, auditors, open records advocates

personas.name: The Builder
personas.one_line: You care about jobs, small business, and whether people can get ahead here.
personas.strength: You see how a new shop or a good job can change a whole block. You bring energy to plans that help people earn and grow.
personas.blind_spot: Some of the best things a city does never show up on a paycheck.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the small business founders, tradespeople, and job creators.
personas.archetype_examples: Small business founders, tradespeople, job creators

personas.name: The Guardian
personas.one_line: You want every street to feel safe and every call answered.
personas.strength: You pay attention to what helps people feel safe walking home. You show up for the calls, lights, and crossings that protect a block.
personas.blind_spot: Safety can mean different things to different neighbors, so it helps to ask them.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the first responders, safety organizers, and neighbors who look out for each other.
personas.archetype_examples: First responders, safety organizers, neighbors who look out

personas.name: The Neighbor
personas.one_line: You care about who can afford to live here and what gets built next door.
personas.strength: You notice who is moving in, who is moving out, and why. You speak up at the meetings where the next building gets decided.
personas.blind_spot: The block you know best is one of many, and other blocks may need different things.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the housing advocates, block clubs, and neighborhood planners.
personas.archetype_examples: Housing advocates, block clubs, neighborhood planners

personas.name: The Mentor
personas.one_line: You think a city is only as strong as what it gives its kids.
personas.strength: You think about the kids who will grow up here next. You back the schools, programs, and places that help young people grow.
personas.blind_spot: Grown ups who are struggling need a hand too, and helping them helps kids as well.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the teachers, coaches, and youth mentors.

personas.name: The Caretaker
personas.one_line: You measure a city by how it treats people when they are hurting.
personas.strength: You notice who is being left out and who needs help first. You push for clinics, care, and support that reach people in time.
personas.blind_spot: Taking care of yourself matters too, so you can keep showing up for others.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the public health pioneers, care workers, and mutual aid networks.
personas.archetype_examples: Public health pioneers, care workers, mutual aid networks

personas.name: The Connector
personas.one_line: You want buses that come, streets that work, and everyone able to get around.
personas.strength: You see how roads, buses, and sidewalks link people to jobs, school, and each other. You speak up for the everyday trips most people never think about.
personas.blind_spot: A fix that works for your route may not work for every route.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the transit planners, road crews, and access advocates.
personas.archetype_examples: Transit planners, road crews, access advocates

personas.name: The Organizer
personas.one_line: You believe the answer is more people at the table.
personas.strength: You bring people in and help them find their voice. You know a meeting changes when more neighbors show up.
personas.blind_spot: Some people help in quiet ways, and that counts too.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand in the tradition of community organizers, union hall leaders, and get out the vote captains.
personas.archetype_examples: Community organizers, union hall leaders, vote captains

personas.name: The Steward
personas.one_line: You see the whole picture and refuse to pick just one fight.
personas.strength: You keep many needs in mind at once and see how they connect. You help a group find a plan that works for more people.
personas.blind_spot: Seeing every side is a gift, and sometimes it helps to pick one thing and push hard on it.
personas.archetype_intro: You stand with the coalition builders and public servants who hold many needs at once.
